token='eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJzcG90aWZ5K2JyX3JpdHRAZ21haWwuY29tIiwiZXhwIjoxNjg0NDEyMDk4fQ.mY-AmtuqSGyP5NSqMSvqkqhp7Zi_INQMvEdGncsPPmU'

# Song library: collect song_ids
songs_songlib=apis.spotify.show_song_library(access_token=token, page_index=0, page_limit=20)
print('page0 songlib keys', type(songs_songlib), len(songs_songlib) if isinstance(songs_songlib,list) else songs_songlib.keys())

# paginate song library properly
song_ids=set()
page=0
while True:
    resp=apis.spotify.show_song_library(access_token=token, page_index=page, page_limit=20)
    print('songlib page', page, 'items', len(resp) if isinstance(resp,list) else None)
    if not resp:
        break
    for s in resp:
        song_ids.add(s['song_id'])
    page+=1
    if page>100:
        break
print('total unique song_ids from song library', len(song_ids))

# Album library: collect song_ids from each album
page=0
album_ids=[]
album_song_ids=set()
while True:
    resp=apis.spotify.show_album_library(access_token=token, page_index=page, page_limit=20)
    print('albumlib page', page, 'items', len(resp) if isinstance(resp,list) else None)
    if not resp:
        break
    for a in resp:
        album_ids.append(a['album_id'])
        for sid in a.get('song_ids',[]) or []:
            album_song_ids.add(sid)
    page+=1
    if page>100:
        break
print('total unique song_ids from album library', len(album_song_ids))

# Playlist library: collect song_ids from each playlist
page=0
playlist_song_ids=set()
while True:
    resp=apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=token, page_index=page, page_limit=20)
    print('playlistlib page', page, 'items', len(resp) if isinstance(resp,list) else None)
    if not resp:
        break
    for p in resp:
        for sid in p.get('song_ids',[]) or []:
            playlist_song_ids.add(sid)
    page+=1
    if page>100:
        break
print('total unique song_ids from playlist library', len(playlist_song_ids))

all_song_ids = song_ids | album_song_ids | playlist_song_ids
print('total unique song_ids across all libraries', len(all_song_ids))
print('sample ids', list(all_song_ids)[:10])
